bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the metadata workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs as an individual contribution to the team project.
Cleaned supplied metadata tables using pandas and provided steps; plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.

Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the recorded workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs as an individual contribution to the team project.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out news document groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.

Under supervision, joined document identifiers to publication metadata using pandas merges and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib and documented missing-data handling.
